blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–National University-Archipelago Builders opened its semifinals campaign in emphatic fashion, handing defending champion Criss Cross its first loss of the tournament with a stunning 23-25, 29-27, 26-24, 25-21 victory in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Monday at the Filoil EcoOil Centre. The Bulldogs bounced back from a narrow opening-set defeat by grinding out consecutive wins in the next two frames before pulling away in the fourth to join Indonesian guest team Surabaya Samator at the top of the standings. “We’re happy with the result today.
